description: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database, in Bruce Hahne's BVH conversion -> werk canonical humanoid v1. 31 joints.
derivation: CMU's BVH joint names are close to the Mixamo names the canonical skeleton already ships a map for, and that near-miss is the point of including it. Three joints differ and each one would be a silent error under the shipped map: (1) CMU has LowerBack between Hips and Spine, so CMU's 'Spine' and 'Spine1' are the SECOND and THIRD spine joints, not the first and second -- the shipped mixamo map sends 'Spine' -> spine1 and 'Spine1' -> spine2, which puts the shoulders one joint too low; the geometry says otherwise, because LeftShoulder and RightShoulder are children of Spine1, and the canonical rig hangs its clavicles off spine3. (2) CMU has a two-segment neck, Neck and Neck1; the canonical rig has one. (3) LHipJoint and RHipJoint are zero-length CMU artefacts with no canonical counterpart. Filed as finding S6-1.
